incident_updates.body:
We will be performing scheduled maintenance on parts of our infrastructure starting Tuesday, May 26th at 4:00 PM PT (7:00 PM ET). Maintenance is expected to conclude by 5:00 PM PT (8:00 PM ET).

During this window, we expect brief service impact of a few minutes for select carrier services, including Ascendia USA, Canada Post, and DHL Express, which may include disruption or error responses.

We will be performing scheduled maintenance on parts of our infrastructure starting Wednesday, May 27th at 8:00 AM PT (11:00 AM ET, Wednesday, May 27th). Maintenance is expected to conclude by Wednesday, May 27th at 8:15 AM PT (Wednesday, May 27th at 11:15 AM ET).

During this window, we expect service disruption of up to 10 min for Australia Post V2.

We will be performing scheduled maintenance on parts of our infrastructure starting Wednesday, May 27th at 4:00 PM PT (7:00 PM ET). Maintenance is expected to conclude by 5:00 PM PT (8:00 PM ET).

During this window, we expect brief service impact of a few minutes for select carrier services, including Amazon Shipping, Australia Post, DAI Post, DHL eCommerce Solutions, DPD UK, LSO, Ontrac, Purolator, UPSDAP, and Veho, which may include disruption or error responses.

During this window, we expect service disruption of up to 10 min for Evri and Royal Mail.

incident_updates.body:
We will be performing scheduled maintenance on parts of our infrastructure starting Wednesday, May 27th at 7:00 PM PT (10:00 PM ET, Wednesday, May 27th). Maintenance is expected to conclude by Wednesday, May 27th at 8:00 PM PT (Wednesday, May 27th at 11:00 PM ET).

During this window, we expect service disruption of up to 10 min for Canada Post, Columbus Last Mile, Deutsche Post UK, and DHL eCommerce.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Scheduled Maintenance for DHL Parcel, Optima, TForce, UDSV2

incident_updates.body:
We will be performing scheduled maintenance on parts of our infrastructure starting Wednesday, May 27th at 8:00 PM PT (11:00 PM ET, Wednesday, May 27th). Maintenance is expected to conclude by Wednesday, May 27th at 9:00 PM PT (Thursday, May 28th at 12:00 AM ET).

During this window, we expect service disruption of up to 10 min for DHL Parcel, Optima, TForce, and UDSV2.

We will be performing scheduled maintenance on parts of our infrastructure starting Thursday, May 28th at 4:00 PM PT (7:00 PM ET). Maintenance is expected to conclude by 5:00 PM PT (8:00 PM ET).

During this window, we expect brief service impact of a few minutes for select carrier services, including OSM Worldwide, Royal Mail, Royal Mail v3, UPS, UPS Mail Innovations, and USPS Ship, which may include disruption or error responses.

We will be performing a maintenance on parts of our infrastructure. This will last up to 2 hours. During this time, API calls,  rating and buying may experience intermittent slowness or momentary outages. Each affected request will be retried and there will be no data loss.

incident_updates.body: We will be performing scheduled maintenance on parts of our infrastructure starting Thursday, June 4th at 4:00 PM PT (7:00 PM ET). Other reporting functions will be active during this time.

We will be performing scheduled maintenance on parts of our infrastructure starting Tuesday, June 9th at 4:00 PM PT (7:00 PM ET). Maintenance is expected to conclude by 5:00 PM PT (8:00 PM ET). During this window, we expect our tracking services to be unavailable for a few minutes.

We will be performing scheduled maintenance on parts of our infrastructure starting Wednesday, June 10th at 9:00 PM PT (12:00 AM ET, Thursday, June 11th). This maintenance is expected to last 1 hour.  During this time, we expect there to be disruption to all EasyPost APIs and carrier services for a few minutes.
